title: Type instrument
description: Four red faders sculpt an oversized black glyph on a yellow proofing field.
useCase: Type specimen exploration and immediate visual parameter control.
interaction: Move the faders, select a glyph, or reset the specimen
reducedMotion: Glyph changes are immediate. Faders always respond directly without tweening.
limitations: Uses CSS scale/skew and system Georgia weights. Width and lean are transforms, not variable-font axes; available weights vary by platform.
look: Bright yellow proofing field with one oversized black serif glyph on guide rules, an amber rack of four red-capped vertical faders and a glyph bar.
motion: Faders reshape the glyph instantly via scaleX, skewX and scale, with weight snapping between 400 and 700; a chosen glyph fades and sharpens from 3 px blur over 220 ms.
adapt: Faders in `controls` set `width`, `lean`, `weight` and `scale`, applied to the glyph `span` as an inline transform; `key={glyph}` remounts it to replay `sf-type-glyph`. Replace the three Georgia glyphs and ranges; for a variable font, map faders to its axes.
